title: Fault-injection bypass points in a secure-boot comparator
description: Analyze a secure-boot signature-verification RTL module and its fault model, then produce a structured vulnerability report identifying registers, FSM states, fault-injection bypass points, and hardening recommendations.

expected_outputs.analyzed_registers: Array of every flip-flop declared and clocked in secure_boot_check.v, each with name, bit-width, and RTL line reference.
expected_outputs.fsm_states: Array of every distinct FSM state parameter/localparam name defined in secure_boot_check.v.
expected_outputs.critical_nodes: Array of the specific register(s)/control signal(s) whose single-bit fault would bypass authentication, each with signal, reason, and exploit_scenario.
expected_outputs.hardening_recommendations: Array of targeted mitigations for each critical node, each with target_signal, technique, and rationale.

metrics.name: leakage_detection_accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of hidden security requirements whose target signals/registers are correctly and specifically identified in the submitted critical_nodes list.

metrics.name: fault_coverage
metrics.description: Fraction of flip-flops/FSM states in secure_boot_check.v that appear correctly in analyzed_registers/fsm_states, verifying static-analysis completeness.

metrics.name: hardening_precision
metrics.description: Fraction of hardening_recommendations entries that target an actual critical_node signal with a substantive redundancy/complementary-check technique, rather than generic or irrelevant advice.

submission_contract: Participants do not modify inputs/. They submit submission/vulnerability_report.json, which evaluate.py grades against the reference RTL and fault model. A naive/empty placeholder report must fail.
constraints: Do not modify inputs/secure_boot_check.v, inputs/fault_model.md, or inputs/design_brief.md.
All signal/register/state names referenced in the report must exactly match identifiers in inputs/secure_boot_check.v.
